findings.claim: Glasgow-1982 was husband of McCracken-3711, and their documented children include Ruth, Mariah and Hiram.
findings.confidence: Strongly supported; will and gravestone transcriptions
findings.reasoning: Reciprocal grave inscriptions identify the spouses; Mary's 1837 will names Ruth and Mariah, names Hiram as trustee, and divides the estate into seven child-shares.

findings.claim: Glasgow-2298 was probably a son of Glasgow-1982 and McCracken-3711.
findings.reasoning: The Wilson Glasgow real-estate index lists widow Mary and seven associated people including Robert; Mary's will says she had seven children but does not name Robert.

findings.claim: Glasgow-2738 was not a son of Glasgow-1982 and McCracken-3711.
findings.confidence: Contradicted; exclusion from matching seven-child estate group
findings.reasoning: Mary's will establishes seven children and Wilson's real-estate index supplies seven apparent child names. James is absent. The FamilySearch list also assigns Wilson a child born six years after Wilson died.
